declare
dt_chk boolean;
begin
if :valid_attributes.eff_date is null then

end if;

 PROCEDURE set_timer;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :valid_attributes.attrib_code != :global.attrib_code or
 :valid_attributes.attrib_table != :global.attrib_table
 then 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C30',
 :global.attrib_code||','||
 :global.attrib_table||
 ',','D',chk);

 end if;
IF :valid_attributes.attrib_code != :global.attrib_code and
 :valid_attributes.attrib_table != :global.attrib_table
THEN
 null;
ELSE 
 if :valid_attributes.attrib_code is not null and
 :valid_attributes.attrib_table is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_attributes_don
 WHERE attrib_code = :valid_attributes.attrib_code and
 attrib_table = :valid_attributes.attrib_table ;

 
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C30',
 :valid_attributes.attrib_code||','||
 :valid_attributes.attrib_table||
 ',','U',chk); 

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C30',
 :valid_attributes.attrib_code||','||
 :valid_attributes.attrib_table||
 ',','U',chk); 

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ENABLE_DISABLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE enable_disable (lpMode varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 item_change('ctrl_block.attrib_group',lpMode);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',lpMode);
 
 if lpMode = 'E' then
 set_item_property('pb_attrib_code',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 else
 set_item_property('pb_attrib_code',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end if;
END;
